Objective

Enter and grow in Japan or India

Develop a route to customers, adapt your offer, establish channels and grow your market presence.

Services for this objective

Select an offering to see what it involves.

  • Reach customers in Japan

    Develop a route into Japan, with an adapted offer, suitable local partners and a structured approach to prospective customers.

    4 offerings

    • Japan entry assessment
      What we do
      Assess demand, buyers, competitors and entry requirements.
      What you receive
      An assessment of the opportunity in Japan.
      Why this matters
      Form a realistic view before entering.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An Indian software business seeking Japanese customers

      Discuss this offering

    • Japan-ready offer
      What we do
      Adapt positioning, documentation, contracting and support arrangements.
      What you receive
      An offer prepared for Japanese purchasing expectations.
      Why this matters
      Help buyers evaluate and purchase your offer.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An Indian software business seeking Japanese customers

      Discuss this offering

    • Channel and partner development
      What we do
      Find suitable Japanese partners and support commercial discussions.
      What you receive
      A proposed route to market and partner terms, subject to agreement.
      Why this matters
      Explore local reach and support without building everything yourself.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An Indian software business seeking Japanese customers

      Discuss this offering

    • First-customer development
      What we do
      Approach target accounts and support first-customer discussions.
      What you receive
      An active pursuit with progress against agreed targets.
      Why this matters
      Work towards an initial customer and reference for further sales.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • An Indian software business seeking Japanese customers

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

  • Reach customers in India

    Assess entry options, adapt your offer for Indian buyers and develop the partners and commercial arrangements needed to pursue customers.

    4 offerings

    • India entry-option assessment
      What we do
      Compare entry routes for your offer, customer segments and regions.
      What you receive
      A recommended route with its economics.
      Why this matters
      Choose an approach suited to the opportunity.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Opening markets for industrial manufacturers

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese manufacturer exploring India

      Discuss this offering

    • Offer adaptation for Indian buyers
      What we do
      Adjust specifications, pricing, service and financing arrangements with your team.
      What you receive
      An adapted offer.
      Why this matters
      Compete on terms relevant to Indian buyers.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Opening markets for industrial manufacturers

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese manufacturer exploring India

      Discuss this offering

    • Operating and channel partner identification
      What we do
      Find and assess distributors, service firms or manufacturing partners.
      What you receive
      A qualified shortlist and proposed terms.
      Why this matters
      Access relevant local capabilities without unnecessary investment.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Opening markets for industrial manufacturers

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese manufacturer exploring India

      Discuss this offering

    • Local commercial set-up
      What we do
      Support commercial arrangements with legal and tax specialists.
      What you receive
      Proposed arrangements, implemented as the parties agree.
      Why this matters
      Prepare the business to trade and support customers.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Opening markets for industrial manufacturers

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

  • Grow your market presence

    Build on your first customers or existing presence by strengthening channels, developing partners and reaching more prospective buyers.

    4 offerings

    • Growth and channel review
      What we do
      Review customers, channels, partner performance and untapped segments.
      What you receive
      A diagnosis of growth constraints and opportunities.
      Why this matters
      Understand where growth may be falling short.

      Discuss this offering

    • Channel and partner network development
      What we do
      Identify additional partners and improvements to existing arrangements.
      What you receive
      Partner candidates and an improvement plan.
      Why this matters
      Extend reach while considering the cost of expansion.

      Discuss this offering

    • Customer access programme
      What we do
      Develop relationships with target accounts over an agreed period.
      What you receive
      A tracked pipeline of qualified opportunities.
      Why this matters
      Build a more systematic approach to customer development.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Helping Indian manufacturers reach US customers
      • Developing a US market for products made in India
      • Positioning a region for technology investment

      Discuss this offering

    • Expansion plan
      What we do
      Define target segments, regions, investments and milestones.
      What you receive
      A plan for the next stage of growth.
      Why this matters
      Make expansion deliberate and measurable.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Shaping a ten-market growth strategy

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service
